in_urdu.name: باقی

The site serves as a reminder of the Prophet’s legacy and the importance of upholding the teachings and values of Islam. Many believe that visiting Baqi and other holy sites is an act of devotion and a means of seeking spiritual enrichment and closeness to Allah. Ultimately, Baqi represents a connection to the Prophet Muhammad and the rich history of Islam.
